## History

God is mentioned by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) whether God would laugh if [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) made a face while God was watching him. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) also wonders what would happen if he tricked God.
